[<- Back to TN Simulation](index.qmd)

The MPS state with truncation dimension $\chi$ forms the MPS manifold:
$$
\mathcal M_\chi = \{ \text{bond dimension less than } \chi \text{ 的 MPS} \},
$$
While the real evolution derivative $-iH\ket{\psi}$ do not in this manifold.
One thus find:
$$
\begin{align*}
|\dot\psi\rangle=
\arg\min_{v\in T_\psi\mathcal M_\chi}
\left\|v+iH|\psi\rangle\right\|^2, \quad |\dot\psi\rangle \in T_\psi \mathcal M_\chi
\end{align*}
$$
